allocationGc.scope: Explicit native command epoch windows; JFR allocation weights and GC heap observations
limitations: Allocation sample weights are estimates, not exact bytes/objects or retained heap.
Sample weights can cover allocation before the timestamp boundary.
GC heap observations are sparse and do not measure RSS or native memory.
Prior heap observation age is retained; it is not a command-start snapshot.
GC event duration is not CPU duration; pause overlap uses GCPhasePause only.
Single diagnostic pair cannot establish causal regression or stable benefit.

commandHotspots.scope: Same-recording epoch time vs explicit three native command windows; triangulation-stack condition
limitations: Sample counts are not calls, CPU duration or removable-time estimates.
Java and native samples must not be added to infer CPU proportions.
JIT inlining can attribute native callees to caller BCIs; map exact installed method bytes.
Truncated or empty stacks limit attribution; separate counters retain those observations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Candidate RSS difference reflects distinct heap/GC trajectories
hypotheses.observation: Committed heap already3712vs2400MiB before first command; candidate cycles2/3 have no in-window GC
hypotheses.conclusion: Supported as confounder, not causal proof or reason to waive original gates

hypotheses.observation: Vector sampled allocation weight falls18.40%, total weight2.26%; wall only0.89% and settle dominates Java leaves
hypotheses.conclusion: Does not support another vector integration attempt

hypotheses.hypothesis: General pending-loop unrolling addresses settle hotspot
hypotheses.observation: Exact deployed BCI163 is already specialized two-pending scan; BCI92 single scan
hypotheses.conclusion: Reject broad pending-loop unrolling as next target

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inline first two bucket entries can reduce index allocation without changing removal proof
hypotheses.observation: Current bucket uses ArrayList(2) plus backing array; captured put stacks show both allocations
hypotheses.conclusion: Next owned differential prototype; no production or host benefit claim
